Product Updates Q3-2020
Seamless proctoring experience on all devices and platforms.
Proctor Web-based Assessments in iPad
Proctoring candidates on your web-based assessments is no more a hassle. Our new Talview Proview Proctoring app for iOS devices will now enable you to proctor candidates easily. Candidates can attend the assessment securely while our solution integrates with any assessment tool seamlessly.
Proctoring SDK for Android apps
Proctoring on Android devices just got easier! Simple integration with Talview Proview Proctoring SDK is all it takes for you to have a proctoring solution on your app. Talview Proview Proctoring SDK integrates with any assessment platform seamlessly to provide an easier than ever proctoring experience!
Talview Candidate app for iPad
Talview Candidate app is the one-stop solution for all your Online Assessments and Video Interviewing needs! Now, candidates can take up remote proctored assessments across all iOS devices - be it an iPhone or an iPad, we got it all covered!
